summary:
Our project, Stars Above, Earth in Our Hearts, is a storytelling and educational comic book about five NASA Mars rovers: Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, and Perseverance. We developed a collection of illustrated stories that present each rover as a character with its own journey, challenges, discoveries, and message to Earth. The project transforms complex space exploration into an emotional and accessible format for high school students.

The stories highlight how the rovers explored ancient environments, searched for evidence of water and possible past life, overcame mechanical and environmental challenges, and expanded our understanding of Mars. The project addresses the challenge of making space science engaging and meaningful to young people by combining scientific information with creative storytelling and visual communication.

This project is important because these small explorers represent human curiosity, persistence, and the courage to explore the unknown. Although some rovers have stopped moving, their discoveries continue to inspire future generations to ask questions, protect Earth, and dream about exploring other worlds.
details:
OUR FINAL MESSAGE

Stars Above, Earth in Our Hearts

Five little explorers travelled millions of kilometres away from home. They crossed red deserts, discovered ancient secrets, faced unexpected challenges, and showed us that even the smallest machines can make a huge difference.

Some are still exploring. Others have become silent forever.

But none of them are forgotten.

Their wheels may have stopped, but their stories continue.

And somewhere, under the endless Martian sky, their little footprints are still waiting to be found.

We may have left them on Mars, but we will always keep them in our hearts.
